title: Regularity after purely inseparable base change of generic fibre
statement: Let A be a Noetherian complete local domain and q a maximal ideal of A[X] contracting to its maximal ideal. For every finite purely inseparable extension L of κ(0) of A[X], the ring L ⊗_{κ(0)} (κ(0) ⊗_{A[X]} completion(A[X]_q)) is regular. The definitions are those of def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-pbc-g-ring.

proof.text: Reduce by the finite regular complete coefficient subring and quasi-finite formal-fibre ascent. For the regular model, localize the regular completion to prove regularity in characteristic zero; finite purely inseparable extensions are trivial. In positive characteristic the Cohen-ring model is excluded by injectivity and characteristic zero, so apply 07PR for the power-series-field model with one polynomial variable and transport the polynomial and completion isomorphisms. Quasi-finite ascent gives regularity after all the stated extensions.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight related fibre/quasi-finite results; none proves this regularity statement.

Existing regular-power-series generic fibre concerns no polynomial variable; 07PR is the positive-characteristic model case already in proof dependencies. FibreRingNoetherian proves the other component and is used directly.

mathlib_searches.query: Every finite purely inseparable base change of the generic formal fibre of a polynomial ring over a complete local domain is regular

theorem completeLocalGenericFibre_regularPart
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal]
    (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    ∀ (k' : Type (max u u)) [Field k']
      [Algebra (⊥ : Ideal (Polynomial A)).ResidueField k']
      [Module.Finite (⊥ : Ideal (Polynomial A)).ResidueField k']
      [IsPurelyInseparable (⊥ : Ideal (Polynomial A)).ResidueField k'],
      IsRegularRing
        (k' ⊗[(⊥ : Ideal (Polynomial A)).ResidueField]
          ((⊥ : Ideal (Polynomial A)).Fiber
            (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
              (Localization.AtPrime q))))
